reading.title: Void Libra Moon Under Uranus-Pluto Trine
overview: The Sun stands at 15° Scorpio with Mercury retrograde at 8° Scorpio. The Moon at 27° Libra remains void of course until 22:00 UTC before entering Scorpio. Venus at 24° Libra retrograde rules the chart while Mars at 22° Leo conjoins Jupiter at 25° Leo.

Outer-planet aspects include Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trine Pluto at 3° Aquarius, Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextile Pluto, and Uranus sextile Neptune. Saturn at 9° Aries retrograde conjoins Neptune. These configurations point to gradual structural shifts and constrained expansion in mundane tradition.
The last New Moon at Libra 17° fell in the eleventh house for the United States and the sixth house for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran. The next New Moon arrives 9 November at Scorpio 17°.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 1.08° while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus at 0.04°. These contacts coincide with reports of GPS jamming in North American cells and freight-rate movements, though the brief notes PLA posture around Taiwan remains consistent with prior exercises.

Neptune squares the natal Sun at 1.42° and Pluto conjoins natal Saturn at 1.97°. Mars squares natal Pluto at 0.05°. Today's reporting includes a possible Xi-Trump-Putin meeting and Ukrainian strikes on refineries, with the latter showing lower z overlap.

Saturn squares natal Sun at 0.5° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter at 0.15°. Jupiter trines natal Mercury at 0.39°. The Uranus-Pluto trine registers high z scores on markets for the 2026 local elections.

reading.lore_and_intel: Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto align with high-z election markets for Taiwan's DPP and KMT outcomes and with port-strike deferral reporting; Venus sextile Jupiter overlaps with papal health and Paraguay banking items. Mars conjunction Jupiter touches Syria-Yemen cooperation notes at moderate z. Several other aspects such as Mercury square Pluto show mixed or lower z matches with White House race coverage, and many listed transits lack corresponding high-z intel overlaps.

watch.note: Mercury and Venus both station direct

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflicted days produce no better than chance results for Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts and Russian losses. Full moons and eclipses likewise register no better than chance against earthquake counts and conflict indicators. The tested claims therefore perform at chance levels.
